page.title: Dental, Vision & Hearing Coverage | AltaMedicare
page.description: Original Medicare doesn’t cover routine dental, vision, or hearing. Here are your options through Medicare Advantage and standalone plans.

header.ledeHtml: Original Medicare doesn’t cover routine dental, vision, or hearing care — but you have options.

gaps.introHtml: Many people are surprised to learn that Original Medicare (Parts A and B) doesn’t cover most of what we think of as “everyday” healthcare:
items: Routine dental cleanings, fillings, crowns, dentures
Routine eye exams, glasses, or contact lenses
gaps.goodNews: The good news: there are several ways to add this coverage.

cards.textHtml: Most Medicare Advantage plans include dental, vision, and hearing benefits at no extra premium. Coverage levels vary by plan — some include only cleanings and exams, while others cover crowns, dentures, and hearing aids with meaningful allowances.
cards.note: If dental, vision, and hearing are important to you, this is often the simplest path.

cards.h2Html: Option 2: Standalone Dental, Vision & Hearing Plans
cards.textHtml: Available alongside Original Medicare and Medicare Supplement plans. These let you keep the doctor flexibility of Original Medicare/Supplement while adding ancillary coverage. Premiums and benefits vary widely.
Some dental and vision discount programs aren’t insurance, but offer reduced rates at participating providers. Useful for occasional needs without committing to a full insurance premium.

lookFor.intro: When comparing dental, vision, and hearing benefits:

items.d: how much will the plan pay per year?
can you use major benefits right away, or do you have to wait?
is your dentist or audiologist included?
some plans offer $1,000+, others much less
how much toward frames and lenses each year?

fit.textHtml: If dental work, hearing aids, or eye care matter to you, tell us — we’ll help you compare plans where these benefits actually shine. Some plans have great dental but minimal hearing; others are the reverse. The right choice depends on what you actually need.

cta.textHtml: One free, no-pressure call — clear answers, no sales pitch.
